meta.title: Point of sale · Clafina
meta.description: A till that keeps selling when the internet goes down. Every sale lands in the ERP as an invoice and a receipt, with stock and cash counted.

hero.title: A till that keeps selling when the internet goes down.
hero.lede: Sell at the counter or at the table, online or off. Every sale lands in the ERP once, with the stock it took and the money it brought in.

jobs.title: Serve the queue, online or off
jobs.body: The till writes every sale down first, then syncs. When the line drops, it keeps selling within the allowances you set.

jobs.title: Close the shift with cash counted
jobs.body: Each shift starts with a float and ends with a count. Any difference is shown, and so are sales that could not sync.

jobs.title: See sales by till, cashier and hour
jobs.body: Reports show what each till and each cashier sold, how people paid, voids, cash differences and time spent offline.

tour.title: Run a busy service
tour.body: In restaurant mode the till shows the menu with what is left, the order for each table, and sends dishes to the kitchen.
points: A floor plan of your tables, and table service
Service charge and VAT on the order
Recipes take their ingredients out of stock

tour.title: Take payment however it comes
tour.body: Split one bill across several ways to pay. The till works out what is still owed and the change to give.
points: Cash, card, transfer, points, gift card, store credit, wallet or on account
Returns are refunded the way the sale was paid
Receipts print on a receipt printer, which can open the cash drawer

tour.title: Keep the kitchen in step
tour.body: The kitchen display shows each ticket for its station, coloured by how long it has waited.
points: Bump a ticket when it is ready, and recall it if you need to
Each station sees only its own dishes

faq.q: What happens when the internet goes down?
faq.a: The till keeps selling. Each sale is written down on the till and synced when the line is back. Offline, each product sells only up to the allowance the ERP set.

faq.q: What can the till run on?
faq.a: The native till runs on desktop computers with macOS, Windows or Linux, and on Android tablets and phones. There is also a browser till that works offline.

faq.q: Can one bill be paid in more than one way?
faq.a: Yes. Split it across cash, card, transfer, points, a gift card, store credit, a wallet or the customer's account. The till shows what is left and the change to give.
